title: Positive probability and total influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Write $p$ for the probability that $f=1$ under the uniform distribution on the cube, and let $I(f)$ be the sum over coordinates of the uniform expectation of the squared discrete derivative of $f$. Then $2p\log_2(1/p)\le I(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
